mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market tightening, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not exceed +1.5% in 70% of triggered instances, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices indicates a robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the next month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-month rolling window, or returns fail to correlate with the interaction index (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals approaching peak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite GDPC1 declining below its 12-month average in the regime, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals labor market strength, fostering optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 150,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not exceed +1% in 70% of triggered instances, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing demand (HOUST) and industrial production (RSAFS) indicate broad economic growth, enhancing corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS increase in the next month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.1 over any 6-month rolling window, or returns fail to correlate with the interaction index (Pearson r < 0.4).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in supply-side indicators (INDPRO and RSAFS) signals robust production capacity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and RSAFS increase in the next month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.1 over any 6-month rolling window, or returns fail to correlate with the interaction index (Pearson r < 0.4).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE <4%), sustained labor market strength drives investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not exceed +1% in 80% of instances within the regime, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
